Definition: of Hebrew origin (H472); Elisabet, an Israelitess:--Elisabeth.
BiblicalUsage: Elisabet is an Israelitess. In Luke 1:5, the text says "and her name [was] Elisabeth." The life behind the name is told on the Elizabeth People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elisábet matters because God knows His people by name, and Elisábet is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
